title: Conditional Probability
summary: Update the relevant sample space when new information is revealed.
recognitionCues: The problem says given that, conditional on, or reveals partial information.
The observation rules out some previously possible outcomes.
The denominator should change after the new information arrives.

title: Linearity of Expectation
summary: Compute an expected total by decomposing it into simpler contributions, even when those contributions are dependent.
recognitionCues: The target is an expected count or total.
The total can be written as a sum of smaller random variables.
Finding the complete distribution looks much harder than finding individual expectations.

title: First-Step Analysis
summary: Condition on the next outcome and express an unknown expectation in terms of simpler states, sometimes including itself.
recognitionCues: The process repeats until a stopping condition occurs.
After one step, the process either finishes, restarts, or moves to one of a few states.
The desired expectation can be related recursively to expectations from those states.
